study: Few trending names, kept all day, buy their %R dips - instead of find -> book -> wait for the arm.
registered_at: 2026-10-17 ~02:00 ET, before any return of this design was computed.
origin: Operator 10/17: '%R and RSI are directionally correct ... they find the names, but they're in at the tail end ... maybe keep a few names and just keep an eye on them, make profit off a few volatile names that are trending - watching their dips and buying the trends based on the %R. Maybe the whole process of finding names, having them on the book, then waiting for the arms is preventing us from entering when we should.'
prior: LOW-MEDIUM. Related evidence: day-hold pilot (hold 2-3 morning picks all day) +17 bp/day vs random -30 (t 1.5, forward); 'up > 2.35% + first 76 min holds' runway predictor held on 60 days; but buying oversold dips on board names (OSL) FAILED and the unscreened OSL read ~0 (n 115k); the screened board fades.
data: Warehouse, pinned: 119 sessions 2026-04-28..2026-10-15, half A <= 2026-07-23. SELECTION uses ALL liquid names in the day-file (not the 400 sample). Lines: IEX %R warmed on the previous session's last 220 IEX bars. Markouts: SIP.
selection: At 10:30, using SIP bars through the 10:29 close only: day change = 10:29 close / previous session's last SIP close - 1; keep names with day change >= +2% AND the 10:29 close above the 09:30-09:59 opening-range high; rank by day change; the top N are watched 10:31-15:30.
entry: The EARLIEST bar of a dip-and-turn in a watched name: fast %R <= dip on one of the last 5 bars (incl. this one), fast rising now (> previous + 0.05), IEX close above the previous session's last SIP (15:59) close (still up on the day). Entry at the SIP open of the next minute, 10-minute hold, 15-minute refractory per name, 10:31-15:30.
controls_cost: lift = markout minus the same name's random LATER minute (entry+1..+60, seed early-honest-v1, rule TRENDDIP); cross = markout minus a random other watched-or-comparison name at the same minute; 10 bp for PASS, 3 bp for PROMISING; day-equal, day-clustered t.
protocol: Pick ONE cell on half A: the highest day-equal lift among cells with >= 150 A signals and >= 30 A days. Confirm on held-out half B only.
pass: B: lift >= +5 bp, t >= 2.0, net at 10 bp > 0, cross > 0, >= 100 signals, >= 6 days. PROMISING: B lift > 0, t >= 1.5, net at 3 bp > 0, cross > 0. Else FAIL / UNDERPOWERED. If indicator failures exceed 1% of name-days, every B verdict is UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: the same dip rule on a seeded 100-name comparison sample (does trend selection matter for the dip?)
random 10-minute holds in the trending names vs the comparison names (does the trend persist after 10:30?)
10:31 open -> close hold of the trending names vs the comparison names (the day-hold idea)
the picked cell's held-out B lift with the 3 best B days dropped

macro split (operator 10/17 'macro vs micro trend'): trending-name dip lift for names whose previous-session adjusted close is above its 50-session average AND above its close 20 sessions earlier ('up') vs the rest ('other'), per cell, pooled (daily data from ai_reports/gapdown/daily.pkl, known before the open)
no_retuning: 2% / opening-range rule / 10:30 / 5 dip bars / the grid / the pick rule / the split / hold / controls / cost are fixed.
if_pass: Forward test on paper as a separate 'trending few' desk mode for >= 10 sessions, then result-skeptic review.
if_fail: Buying %R dips in the day's trending names has no edge at these settings; read the information lines (does the trend persist? does holding pay?) for the 10/30 verdict.
declared_deviations: The live desk could seat these names on the 50-name stream; this tests the signal, not the plumbing.
selection eligibility: SIP+IEX prior-session bars and >= 1 IEX bar before 10:30

amended_1.at: 2026-10-17 ~02:30 ET, after the single result-skeptic round (F1-F4) and the operator's macro/micro request, before any score.
amended_1.fixes: F1 eligibility before the top-N slice and known at 10:30; F2 counted indicator failures with a 1% UNDERPOWERED rule; F3 drop-3-best-B-days info; F4 entry text and declared deviation. Plus the macro split (information only).
